requiemunofficial:dialogue.first_contact: You hear a voice talking to you, but you can't quite put your finger on where it's coming from.
I do not want anything to do with this.

Reject your humanity, and become cursed with eternity. Refuse, and keep to your ordinary lives among others. This is an opportunity to get a whole new experience when you die, but taking it means changing your habits.

If you follow this path, you will have to find a new body each time you die. The powers you acquire will be of great use when that happen, and the bodies you find may well be more interesting than the standard human body you are used to.
If you follow this path, you will miss on everything Requiem has to offer. You will respawn as usual, and be able to play as a human right after dying.
Are you sure you want to become a demon?
Are you sure you want to stay human?

origins:origin.requiem.mortal.name: Mortal
origins:origin.requiem.mortal.descriptio: A mere mortal. Your ordinary Minecraft experience awaits.
origins:origin.requiem.remnant.name: Demon
origins:origin.requiem.remnant.descripti: Tales have been told of mysterious demons taking over the bodies of the dead. No one really knows what they are, but few really want to find out.
origins:origin.requiem.vagrant.name: Vagrant
origins:origin.requiem.vagrant.descripti: A demon outside of a congruous body. Condemned to wander and take over weaker entities to act as proxies with the physical world.

origins:power.requiem.remnant.descriptio: When you die, your soul dissociates from your body, becoming a wandering ghost.
origins:power.requiem.damned.name: Damned
origins:power.requiem.damned.description: Your only way to get a new human body is to get cured while possessing a suitable creature.

origins:power.requiem.freeform.descripti: Ghosts can move through the air and, with a bit of effort, even through walls.

origins:power.requiem.resurrection.name: Death Grip
origins:power.requiem.resurrection.descr: Under some circumstances, your soul may hold on to your disfigured body after its death.
origins:power.requiem.soul_mending.name: Soul Mending
origins:power.requiem.soul_mending.descr: Your soul slowly mends itself during possession.
origins:power.requiem.banished.name: Banished
origins:power.requiem.banished.descripti: You cannot get a new human body by curing other creatures.
origins:power.requiem.mortal.name: Respawn
origins:power.requiem.mortal.description: When you die, and if all goes well, you find yourself at your last resting point with a whole new body.

jei.requiemunofficial.info.opus_daemoniu: Opus Daemonium is the readable book form. Use the sealed or pure vessel versions to change soul state.
jei.requiemunofficial.info.humanity: Humanity is a treasure enchantment used by possessed item users. Level I allows humanity-style kills but suppresses experience; level II allows experience.
jei.requiemunofficial.info.empty_soul_ve: Hold use on a living target to channel soul capture. The soul is removed only when the channel finishes successfully.
jei.requiemunofficial.info.filled_soul_v: Stores captured soul data. Active obelisks can absorb filled vessels as stored soul energy.
jei.requiemunofficial.info.sealed_remnan: Curses a mortal soul into remnant state and returns an empty vessel.
jei.requiemunofficial.info.pure_soul_ves: Cures a remnant or vagrant soul back toward mortal state and returns an empty vessel. Possessed-body cure still follows the cure lifecycle.
jei.requiemunofficial.info.totem_of_skel: Used by transformation and resurrection rules as the skeletonization catalyst.
jei.requiemunofficial.info.runestones: Runestones are used in obelisk and rift structures. Runic tachylite variants provide the corresponding Requiem effects when the structure is active.
